details.title: Strategic Partnership Agreement
details.governing_law: laws of the State of Delaware
details.courts_or_seat: state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware... Any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California

details.parties_quote:
**Datavane, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 575 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, California 94105, USA ("**Datavane**"); and

**AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd**, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("**Partner**").

payment_source.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

details.services_summary: Partner provides data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and business intelligence services as a non-exclusive implementation and referral partner for Datavane.

liability_cap.basis: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).
liability_cap.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).

details.one_sided_note: Confidentiality obligations apply to both, but Section 9.4 extends trade secret and Datavane Account protection indefinitely while general confidentiality ends 3 years post-termination.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Partner shall not solicit, market to, or provide implementation or consulting services to any Datavane Account for other data platforms during the term and for 24 months post-termination.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform
restrictive_covenants.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Partner grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use submitted feedback, connectors, templates, or implementation accelerators.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: Submitting feedback, connectors, templates, or implementation accelerators to the Datavane Partner Marketplace grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence.
restrictive_covenants.quote: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits to the Datavane Partner Marketplace.

findings.title: AtliQ Pvt Ltd named for a US client
findings.why: US clients contract with AtliQ Inc.
findings.comparison: Entity sheet: AtliQ Inc serves the United States only.
findings.quote:
**Datavane, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 575 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, California 94105, USA ("**Datavane**"); and

**AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd**, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("**Partner**").

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: Datavane is a lakehouse platform and AtliQ acts as a referral/implementation partner in India and GCC countries, directly conflicting with CloudSpan's exclusivity commitment for competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platforms.
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Broad Non-Compete restricting services to Datavane Accounts
findings.why: Restricts AtliQ from providing data platform services to clients for 24 months post-termination, conflicting with AtliQ's business.
findings.comparison: AtliQ's principles state no clash with promises AtliQ has already made; this is a heavy restriction.
findings.quote: directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

findings.title: Unilateral termination for convenience by Datavane
findings.why: Allows Datavane to exit abruptly while AtliQ remains bound.
findings.comparison: Creates imbalance compared to standard mutual termination rights.
findings.quote: Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner.

findings.title: No termination for convenience for Partner
findings.why: Denies AtliQ the right to walk away for convenience, locking AtliQ in.
findings.comparison: One-sided restriction not standard in balanced AtliQ agreements.
findings.quote: Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.

findings.title: Forfeiture of unpaid revenue share upon termination
findings.why: AtliQ risks losing earned compensation for work done if termination occurs before client payment.
findings.comparison: Violates the principle that AtliQ must be paid for work done on termination.
findings.quote: no revenue share or referral fee shall be payable in respect of any Joint Deal or referral not fully paid by the relevant Datavane Account before the effective date of termination

findings.title: Perpetual license to Partner connectors and accelerators
findings.why: Surrenders perpetual rights to AtliQ's pre-existing tools and accelerators.
findings.comparison: Departs from standard practice where AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools.
findings.quote: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits

findings.title: Uncapped and One-Sided Partner Indemnity
findings.why: Exposes AtliQ to unlimited financial exposure for broad claims without reciprocity.
findings.comparison: Principles require mutual indemnity; past contracts do not have uncapped vendor indemnities.
findings.quote: Partner's obligations under this Section 11.1 shall not be subject to any limitation or cap.

findings.title: Partner Liability Excluded from Caps
findings.why: AtliQ's liability is completely uncapped for multiple sections, violating our liability principles.
findings.comparison: Principles prefer a 1x cap; 8 of 10 past contracts cap liability at 1x.
findings.quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.

findings.title: Unilateral Program Terms Amendments
findings.why: Allows Datavane to unilaterally change core program terms and obligations without AtliQ's consent.
findings.comparison: Principles require mutual agreement for amendments; unilateral changes create unseen risks.
findings.quote: Datavane may update the Global Partner Program Guide, certification requirements and Partner Portal terms from time to time upon notice

findings.title: Indian entity under non-Indian law (laws of the State of Delaware)
findings.why: Disputes would be fought under foreign law and courts.
findings.comparison: Principle: India for AtliQ Pvt Ltd. Past exceptions (Al Noor DIFC, Northwind English law) were deliberate.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware... Any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California

findings.title: Payment in 60 days
findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
findings.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

findings.title: Automatic renewal for successive one-year periods
findings.why: Locks AtliQ into extended terms automatically unless Datavane opts out.
findings.comparison: Past contracts do not typically feature unilateral auto-renewal favoring the client.
findings.quote: successive one (1) year periods unless Datavane gives notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days

findings.title: Asymmetric Assignment Rights
findings.why: Prevents AtliQ from assigning the contract freely while Datavane can transfer it unilaterally.
findings.comparison: Creates an imbalance in contractual rights between the parties.
findings.quote: Partner may not assign this Agreement... without Datavane's prior written consent. Datavane may assign this Agreement without consent.

findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
findings.why: AtliQ provides data analytics and AI services in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman, which overlaps with Al Noor's non-compete scope if Datavane clients are in hospitality.
findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.
